description: South Korea 2026 housing property tax (주택 재산세) from the official price: fair market value ratio (43-45% for one-home households, 60% otherwise), one-home special rate up to 900M KRW, urban area tax and local education tax. Same formulas as tools.oiyo.net. Excludes comprehensive real estate holding tax and the burden cap.

oneHouse.description: One house per household (1세대1주택), default true

urbanArea.description: Inside an urban planning area (도시지역분 0.14%), default true
